response.sql: WITH per_rental AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_sum, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_sum) AS avg_payment_sum, AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payment_count FROM per_rental GROUP BY store_id

assumptions.assumption: The 4.99 cutoff means payments of at least 4.99. The request does not specify the direction or whether the boundary is inclusive.
